Welcome to the documentation for @tcbs/react-native-mazic-ui - a customizable React Native UI component library.
The TcbsButton component is a highly customizable button with icon support and theme integration.

Prop Type Default Description title string - Button text onPress (event: GestureResponderEvent) => void Required Callback function when pressed size 'large' | 'medium' | 'small' 'large' Button size variant 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'no_border' 'primary' Button style variant disabled boolean false Disable button interaction iconName string - Icon name from icon library iconGroup string 'MaterialIcons' Icon library to use iconPosition 'top' | 'left' | 'right' 'top' Position of the icon accessibilityLabel string - Accessibility label style StyleProp<ViewStyle> - Additional styles textStyle StyleProp<TextStyle> - Additional text styles
<TcbsButton title="Check" iconName="check" iconGroup="AntDesign" iconPosition="left" onPress={() => console.log('Pressed')} />

<TcbsButton title="Large" size="large" variant="primary" onPress={() => console.log('Pressed')} /> <TcbsButton title="Medium" size="medium" variant="secondary" onPress={() => console.log('Pressed')} /> <TcbsButton title="Small" size="small" variant="no_border" onPress={() => console.log('Pressed')} />
The button automatically adapts to the current theme: Primary: Uses primary color from theme Secondary: Uses border and text color from theme No Border: Transparent background with themed text color

The AppErrorBoundary component provides graceful error handling for React Native applications.

<AppErrorBoundary fallbackDev={({ error, reset }) => ( <View style={{ flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }}> <Text>DEV: Something went wrong.</Text> <Text>{error?.message}</Text> <Text onPress={reset} style={{ color: 'blue', marginTop: 16 }}>Try Again</Text> </View> )} fallbackProd={<Text>PROD: Something went wrong. Please try again later.</Text>} > <YourAppComponents /> </AppErrorBoundary>
Catches render errors in child components Displays helpful fallback UIs for development and production Works with both custom and default fallbacks Logs error details to console for debugging
The CustomText component provides consistent typography with theme support.
Prop Type Default Description children React.ReactNode Required Text content variant 'title' | 'subtitle' | 'body' | 'caption' | 'button' 'body' Text style variant
The library provides comprehensive theme management using Zustand and MMKV.

import { useTcbsColorStore } from '@tcbs/react-native-mazic-ui'; const { setTcbsColor } = useTcbsColorStore(); React.useEffect(() => { setTcbsColor({ light: { btnColor: '#007AFF', btnBorderColor: '#007AFF', btnIconColor: '#16a62bff', themeColor: '#007AFF', btnTextColor: '#FFFFFF', }, dark: { btnColor: '#222222', btnBorderColor: '#222222', btnIconColor: '#FFFFFF', themeColor: '#222222', btnTextColor: '#FFFFFF', }, }); }, []);
The library supports three theme modes: light: Always use light theme colors dark: Always use dark theme colors system: Use system color scheme (respects user's OS preference)
Themes are automatically persisted using MMKV storage, so users' preferences are maintained between app sessions.

The theme system supports extensive color customization through the ThemeColor interface: btnColor: Main button background color btnBorderColor: Button border color btnIconColor: Icon color themeColor: Overall theme color btnTextColor: Button text color
Before installing, make sure you have: React Native 0.68.0 or higher Node.js 18+ installed
npm install @tcbs/react-native-mazic-ui @tcbs/react-native-exception-handler Or with yarn: yarn add @tcbs/react-native-mazic-ui @tcbs/react-native-exception-handler

Welcome to the documentation for @tcbs/react-native-mazic-ui - a customizable React Native UI component library. This library provides: TcbsButton - A highly customizable button with icon support Theme Management - Light/dark/system theme support Error Handling - Robust error boundaries Utility Components - Custom cards and text components
✅ Theme support with light/dark/system modes ✅ Multiple icon library integration ✅ Accessibility features ✅ Error boundary for graceful error handling ✅ Persistent theme storage using MMKV
